page.notes: Two printed pages: left column of contents (continuing from Liber XII through Liber XIV/XV), right column (Liber XV through Liber XVII). Page number not legibly printed at head or foot; a faint "3" appears in the foot of the right column beside a bracket and "IX. De" follows, likely a catchword or signature remnant. Some entries are partly illegible or uncertain, notably the Greek phrase in XVII ("…ξ…" rendered as ellipsis) and the entry "Argumenta Carerij". The top-left page portion may be the continuation of an index before Liber XII. Ink and scan damage at right edges; some page numbers in the right column (e.g. 308, 309, 311) are small and approximate.
